Hero.description: KivuLingua AI is an initiative dedicated to the creation of the first open infrastructure for speech data and AI models for Eastern Congo's Bantu languages, beginning with Mashi (1.9M speakers). We build ethical ASR and TTS systems anchored in real-world use cases: literacy education via Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL) and community health communication, ensuring continuous linguistic datafication and digital sovereignty.

community.description: Native Mashi speakers and contributors already mobilized for community validation, linguistic preservation and participatory data governance.

languages.description: Underrepresented Bantu languages across Eastern Congo (North Kivu, South Kivu) prioritized for sustained ASR, TTS and multilingual AI development.

audio.description: High-quality aligned speech corpus in Mashi collected across diverse genres: read speech, spontaneous conversations, oral narratives and functional content.

open.description: All datasets, models, and tools published under open licenses on Hugging Face, GitHub and Zenodo as African digital public goods.

Research.title: Scientific Infrastructure for African Language Technologies
Research.description: KivuLingua AI develops advanced ASR and TTS systems using open-source frameworks: Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, MMS (Massively Multilingual Speech), SpeechBrain, and Coqui TTS. We evaluate performance through Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), Mean Opinion Score (MOS) and comparative benchmarking. Our research prioritizes ethical data collection, community ownership, and integration with international open-science ecosystems including Hugging Face and Mozilla Common Voice.

Community.title: Collaborative Infrastructure for Digital Linguistic Sovereignty
Community.description: Community participation anchors all KivuLingua AI initiatives. We engage native speakers, teachers, cultural leaders, local radio stations and religious institutions in participatory data collection following international ethical research standards. Linguistic communities co-govern datasets, validate transcriptions, and ensure cultural appropriateness. We prioritize informed consent, data anonymization, and community benefit-sharing while building sustainable African-led AI ecosystems.

Roadmap.title: 12-Month Implementation Timeline (Jul 2026 - Jun 2027)
Roadmap.description: Our strategic roadmap integrates continuous data collection, model development, educational and health pilots, and open ecosystem publication. Each phase builds on community participation, ethical protocols, and measurable impact in real-world use cases.

Objectives.title: Strategic Objectives
Objectives.description: KivuLingua AI is committed to building the first open, ethical, and sustainable infrastructure for voice data and AI models for Mashi, reproducible across all Bantu languages in the Kivu region.

goals.title: Collect Open Speech Data
goals.description: Gather and publish at least 250 hours of validated Mashi vocal corpus, balanced by gender, age, and dialectal variant from 200+ native speakers

goals.title: Develop Open-Source ASR
goals.description: Create an edge-optimized ASR model for Mashi (CPU-only, offline, <1B parameters) using Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, and MMS fine-tuning

goals.title: Develop TTS System
goals.description: Build an initial TTS model for Mashi using Coqui TTS for accessible speech synthesis and educational content generation

goals.title: Deploy Educational Pilot
goals.description: Implement Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL) literacy program in 5+ rural Bushi schools serving 500+ students in mother-tongue education

goals.title: Deploy Health Pilot
goals.description: Equip 30+ community health workers with mobile app for offline voice data collection in Mashi-speaking regions

goals.title: Build Reproducible Pipeline
goals.description: Create documented, open-source infrastructure enabling cost-effective extension to 8 other Kivu Bantu languages in Phase 2

goals.title: Train Community Contributors
goals.description: Build capacity of 50+ local data collectors, transcribers, and validators in ethical data practices and quality standards

goals.title: Publish All Resources
goals.description: Release corpus, models, tools, and benchmarks under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face, Zenodo, and GitHub as African digital public goods

UseCases.title: Real-World Impact Through Education & Health
UseCases.description: KivuLingua AI resources directly serve two high-impact use cases that anchor the entire data collection strategy.

cases.title: Literacy Education (TaRL)
cases.description: Teaching at the Right Level (TaRL) approach in mother-tongue Mashi for rural Bushi schools. Children learn to read in their native language with AI-powered audio content through the Ntina platform.
cases.impact: 500+ students, 5 schools, measurable improvement in foundational literacy

cases.title: Community Health
cases.description: Community health workers use voice-based mobile app to deliver prevention messages in Mashi (vaccination, maternal health, nutrition) and record patient data offline in rural Eastern DRC.

DataCollection.title: Ethical, Continuous Data Collection
DataCollection.description: Our approach goes beyond episodic data campaigns. Following Fendji's datafication framework, we build infrastructure where teachers and health workers naturally generate contextualized speech data through daily interactions.
DataCollection.approach: Infrastructure Before Annotation: Deploy mobile app first, let natural workflows generate data. Transcription follows, not vice versa.

dataTypes.description: Controlled texts - educational content, health messages, proverbs
Semi-directed dialogues in educational and health contexts
Teaching instructions, prevention messages, patient forms

Technology.title: Open-Source Models & Tools
Technology.description: We develop production-ready AI systems using proven open-source frameworks, optimized for offline deployment in resource-constrained settings.

components.title: ASR Model (Speech Recognition)
components.description: Fine-tuned Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, and MMS for Mashi. Optimized for Edge: <1B parameters, CPU-only, <2x real-time on low-end Android devices

components.title: TTS Model (Speech Synthesis)
components.description: Coqui TTS trained on Mashi corpus for text-to-speech in educational and health applications

components.title: Mobile Collection App
components.description: Co-developed with Kwetu Best Technologies. Android app for offline voice capture, transcription integration, and automatic linguistic data generation

components.title: Reproducible Pipeline
components.description: Complete open-source toolkit: annotation scripts, quality assurance, evaluation benchmarks, documentation—ready for 8 additional Kivu languages

Ethics.title: Ethics, Governance & Community Sovereignty
Ethics.description: Community control over linguistic data comes before open access. We prioritize informed consent, ethical governance, and meaningful benefit-sharing.

principles.description: Mashi community council (Matabaro, Nshombo, Prof. Nkunzimwami) validates all data access terms before publication
Build sustainable systems where data generation is continuous and community-centered, not episodic campaigns
Prioritize robust ongoing data flow over attempting complete linguistic coverage in isolation
Bilingual consent forms (Mashi/French), explicit right of withdrawal, anonymization of personal data
Minimum 50% women contributors across collection, spanning ages 15-65 and 4+ geographic zones
Security of participants prioritized. Data never used for surveillance. No collection in active conflict zones

Team.title: Leadership Driving Language Preservation
Team.description: Our interdisciplinary team combines expertise in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and indigenous language documentation to build sustainable infrastructure for African language technologies.
